sop_modules.name: New Drywall Preparation - Full Prime
sop_modules.description: Prepare new drywall ceiling and wall surfaces for primer application. Includes inspection and dust removal for both surfaces.

required_inputs.notes: Floor SF for subfloor vacuum task

tasks.name: Inspect Ceiling Drywall
tasks.description: Walk ceiling surfaces with work light to identify defects: unfilled joints, damaged paper, ridges, or debris. Mark defects for drywall contractor correction.

quality_notes.QT2: Note only major defects (holes, unfilled joints)
quality_notes.QT3: Identify and mark all visible defects

tasks.name: Inspect Ceiling Drywall (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of ceiling surfaces using work light. Identify all defects including minor ridges, scratches, and texture inconsistencies. QT4 requires comprehensive defect identification.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright light, mark all imperfections

tasks.name: Inspect Wall Drywall
tasks.description: Walk wall surfaces with work light to identify defects: unfilled joints, damaged paper, ridges, or debris. Mark defects for drywall contractor correction.

quality_notes.QT2: Note only major defects (holes, unfilled joints)
quality_notes.QT3: Identify and mark all visible defects

tasks.name: Inspect Wall Drywall (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of wall surfaces using work light. Identify all defects including minor ridges, scratches, and texture inconsistencies. QT4 requires comprehensive defect identification.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright light, mark all imperfections

tasks.name: Vacuum Ceiling Drywall Dust
tasks.description: Remove drywall dust from ceiling surfaces using HEPA vacuum with brush attachment. Work from center outward. Dust left on surface will cause adhesion failure.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick pass to remove loose dust
quality_notes.QT4: Complete vacuum with attention to corners and joints

tasks.name: Vacuum Wall Drywall Dust
tasks.description: Remove drywall dust from wall surfaces using HEPA vacuum with brush attachment. Work top to bottom. Dust left on surface will cause adhesion failure.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick pass to remove loose dust
quality_notes.QT4: Complete vacuum with attention to corners and joints

tasks.name: Vacuum Subfloor (Pre-Prime)
tasks.description: Vacuum subfloor to remove drywall dust that fell during ceiling and wall vacuuming. Reduces airborne dust during primer application that could contaminate wet primer.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick pass to remove visible dust piles
quality_notes.QT4: Complete vacuum of all floor areas

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect ceilings → Inspect walls → Vacuum ceilings → Vacuum walls → Vacuum subfloor. Inspection first to identify issues; vacuum surfaces removes dust before priming; vacuum subfloor removes fallen dust to reduce airborne contamination during application.

sop_modules.name: Protection Setup - Spray Methods
sop_modules.description: Set up protection for windows, doors, fixtures, electrical boxes, and materials before spray application.

tasks.name: Mask Window Openings
tasks.description: Apply plastic film over window openings (rough openings or installed windows), tape perimeter to seal against overspray.

quality_notes.QT4: Precision seal with clean tape lines

tasks.name: Mask Exterior Doors
tasks.description: Apply plastic film over exterior doors in place, tape perimeter to seal against overspray.

quality_notes.QT4: Precision seal with clean tape lines

tasks.name: Protect Recessed Lights and Electrical Boxes
tasks.description: Stuff recessed lighting cans with paper and tape over face. Stuff electrical boxes (outlets, switches, junctions) with paper and tape over face to prevent paint entry and insulation blow-out.

tasks.name: Cover Building Materials and Tools
tasks.description: Cover stored building materials, tools, and equipment in work area with plastic sheeting to protect from overspray.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of all materials in spray zone

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mask windows → Mask doors → Protect room fixtures → Cover materials. All protection must be complete before any primer application.

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer - Roller Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer coat to ceilings and walls using roller. Ceilings first, then walls.

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Ceilings
tasks.description: Apply primer to ceiling field using 9-inch roller with extension pole. Work in sections, maintain wet edge. MUST complete before starting walls.

quality_notes.QT2: Full coverage, minor lap marks acceptable
quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage, no holidays, minimal lap marks
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Textured Ceilings
tasks.description: Apply primer to textured ceiling (orange peel, knockdown) using 9-inch roller with 3/4-inch nap cover. Requires more product and slower application than smooth surfaces.

quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, verify texture valleys filled

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Walls
tasks.description: Apply primer to wall field using 9-inch roller with extension pole. Work in W-pattern, maintain wet edge at ceiling transition.

quality_notes.QT2: Full coverage, minor lap marks acceptable
quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage, no holidays, minimal lap marks
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Textured Walls
tasks.description: Apply primer to textured walls (orange peel, knockdown) using 9-inch roller with 3/4-inch nap cover. Requires more product and slower application than smooth surfaces.

quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, verify texture valleys filled

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Roll ceilings FIRST, then roll walls. Maintain wet edge at ceiling-wall transition to prevent lap marks.

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer - Spray + Backroll Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer via airless spray followed by backroll for consolidation and leveling. Ceilings first, then walls.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Ceilings
tasks.description: Apply primer to ceilings via airless sprayer. Maintain proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Backroller follows immediately.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Ceiling Primer
tasks.description: Immediately follow ceiling spray with 18-inch roller to consolidate primer into surface and eliminate air pockets. Backroller sets pace for sprayer.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Walls
tasks.description: Apply primer to walls via airless sprayer. Maintain proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Work top-to-bottom. Backroller follows immediately.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer
tasks.description: Immediately follow wall spray with 18-inch roller to consolidate primer into surface and eliminate air pockets. Maintain wet edge at ceiling transition.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Spray ceiling → Backroll ceiling (immediately) → Spray walls → Backroll walls (immediately). Backroller must follow sprayer closely - spray rate cannot exceed backroll rate. Complete ceilings before starting walls.

sop_modules.name: Apply Primer - Spray Only Method
sop_modules.description: Apply primer via airless spray without backroll. Faster but may have more visible texture. Ceilings first, then walls.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Ceilings (No Backroll)
tasks.description: Apply primer to ceilings via airless sprayer. Higher overlap required when not backrolling to ensure even coverage. Complete before starting walls.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Walls (No Backroll)
tasks.description: Apply primer to walls via airless sprayer. Higher overlap required when not backrolling. Maintain wet edge at ceiling transition.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Spray ceilings FIRST (complete), then spray walls. No backroll means sprayer must achieve final finish in single pass.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Vacuum subfloors, remove protection, clean tools, final inspection.

required_inputs.notes: Floor SF for subfloor vacuum task

tasks.name: Vacuum Subfloors
tasks.description: Vacuum subfloors to remove primer drips, overspray debris, and dust. Clean floors before next trade or phase.

quality_notes.all: Remove all visible primer debris and dust from subfloor

tasks.name: Remove Protection
tasks.description: Remove all masking from windows, doors. Remove paper from fixtures and electrical boxes. Remove plastic from materials.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water. Store or dispose properly.

tasks.name: Final Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all primed surfaces (ceilings and walls). Check for holidays, missed spots, drips. Touch up as needed.

quality_notes.QT3: Thorough visual, address all visible defects

tasks.name: Final Inspection (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of all primed surfaces (ceilings and walls) using work light. Identify and touch up all imperfections including minor holidays, texture irregularities, and lap marks.

quality_notes.QT4: Detailed inspection with work light, touch up all imperfections

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Vacuum subfloors → Remove protection → Clean tools → Final inspection. Vacuum subfloors after primer application to remove drips and overspray before next phase.

round_configurations.name: Single Prime Round
round_configurations.description: Standard single coat of primer for new drywall ceilings and walls.
round_configurations.notes: Single primer coat is standard for new drywall with topcoat to follow.
